_readme: Evaluated by tests/test_narration_cases.py against ContextAwareAssistant's deterministic templates. Most of these routes are now narratable when risk is LOW/MEDIUM (see _NARRATABLE_ROUTES in app/mobile/session_store.py), so this text is not always the final user-facing text -- it's exercised here both as the Ollama-down/rejected-guardrail fallback and as the input the narrator's grounding/required-verbatim-snippet checks validate against, independent of whether narration is actually attempted (this fixture never calls an LLM). Checked by concept/keyword presence, not exact string match. Cases with skip_reason are documented here for coverage but exercised by a dedicated test elsewhere (they need live HTTP mocking of the Ollama call, which this fixture format does not model).
